regions.today: Dry with sunny spells this afternoon and evening, but cool, and a little breezy. It will be cloudier at times across southern parts of the province. Moderate northeast winds, fresh near the coast.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with long clear spells. Rather chilly with lowest temperatures of 1 to 4 degrees, with a touch of frost possible in sheltered spots, as northerly winds ease mainly light to moderate overnight. A little milder near the coast.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly dry again tomorrow, Sunday, with sunny spells. Cloud amounts will tend to increase from the northwest as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 11 to 15 degrees, in light to moderate northerly winds.
